## What Claude Did

- Read the assignment PDF and the syllabus, and explained what was due this week.
- Wrote the R code for all the apps and tested them in its own environment
  (server logic, rendered plots and page screenshots) before I ran them.
- Offered two or more designs for each app; I chose one each time.
- Guided me through creating a shinyapps.io account and deploying two apps.
- Drafted the English text of the assignment page.

## Prompts

The conversation was in Traditional Chinese. These are the prompts that shaped the
assignment, with English translations.

1. > 這禮拜好像沒有prepare for class 只有assignment 可以告訴我這禮拜要幹嘛嗎 … 然後一步一步帶著我做
   >
   > *(There seems to be no "Prepare for class" this week, only the assignment. Can you
   > tell me what I need to do this week … and then guide me step by step?)*

2. > 那就拿 04_mpg 來改字型吧 還是說其實五個都要改
   >
   > *(Let's use 04_mpg for the fonts. Or do all five apps need to be changed?)*
   >
   > Claude explained that only one app is needed, in two versions.

3. > 這是要我們幹嘛呢 做視覺化的修改嗎 我希望就是根據你的方案選出我想要的方案來修改
   >
   > *(What is this part for? Is it about visual changes? I would like to choose the
   > option I want from your proposals.)*
   >
   > Claude offered three font pairs and two colour schemes. I chose **A1**:
   > Inter with my warm burnt-orange palette from Assignment 5.

4. Part 2 design choices (multiple choice): **scatter plot explorer** for mtcars,
   **state ranking with tabs** for USArrests, and **population growth with a card
   layout** for uspop.

5. > 先用B好了
   >
   > *(Let's use B for now.)* — I chose the Happy Planet Index instead of the team
   > project's TEA data for Part 4, and then chose the **scatter plot with a click-to-see
   > trend** design.

6. > 這裡有說要用學校的帳號嗎 還是怎麼用
   >
   > *(Does it say I have to use my school account? How do I use this?)* — about
   > signing up for shinyapps.io.

7. > 做part5
   >
   > *(Do Part 5.)*

## What I Checked or Changed

- **Missing axis labels in Part 1.** My screenshot of the bslib version showed a
  boxplot without axis labels. Claude found the cause (`boxplot(add = TRUE)` does not
  draw them) and added `title()`.
- **Cut-off text in a narrow window.** When I ran the Part 4 app in the RStudio
  window, the legend, the source note and a country label near the edge were cut off.
  These were fixed, which also matters for the iframe on this page.
- **Collapsed tabs.** In a narrow window the USArrests tabs moved into a ☰ menu;
  Claude explained this is bslib's responsive design, not an error.
- **Deployment warnings.** The first deployment printed ten warnings about font
  files. Claude explained they were harmless, and I confirmed on the live app that
  the page and the plots used Inter.
- **Account name.** I first typed `https://` into the shinyapps.io account box and
  corrected it to `ericadgjl-huang`.
- **Exposed token.** A screenshot I shared showed my shinyapps.io token and secret.
  After deploying, I created a new token, connected RStudio with it and deleted the
  old one.
- I ran every app on my computer and opened both published apps before accepting them.

## Design Decisions That Are Mine

- The font and colour style: Inter with my warm palette (option A1).
- The design of each Part 2 app, chosen from Claude's options.
- The Happy Planet Index as my own data for Part 4, and the click-to-see-trend design.
- Signing up with GitHub and using my GitHub user name as the shinyapps.io account name.
- Doing Part 5 on the same night instead of the next day.
